description: Convert FBX, OBJ (zip with .mtl and textures), glTF (zip), STL, PLY, DAE or 3DS to one GLB: Y-up, in meters, materials and FBX animations kept. Returns the GLB, a report, a validator pass and a preview render. Price: $0.15 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of GLB optimizer: Make a GLB small and fast for the web or mobile: dedup, instance, join, weld, simplify, resize and re-encode textures, meshopt or draco compression.

file.description: Model file as base64: FBX, GLB, STL, PLY, DAE, 3DS, or a ZIP holding an OBJ/glTF with its .mtl/.bin and textures.

fileName.description: Original file name, helps tell the format apart.

unitScale.description: Multiply sizes by this to get meters; auto reads FBX units and treats large STLs as millimeters.

upAxis.description: auto trusts FBX/glTF/DAE metadata, assumes Y-up for OBJ and Z-up for STL/PLY/3DS.

name: glb_optimizer_convert
